_note: Squad rules for the hunters on one level (src/bin/last_route/hunters/director.rs). share_*: a spotter calls idle hunters within share_radius, each coming with share_chance, at most team per call and cap committed per runner. flank / cover: odds that a team member after the first flanks the sighting or covers the nearest relay exit. gap: crowding distance for scatter. interval: seconds between director passes. rushers: free hunters the relay rush sends out. hear_radius / hear_flank: a free hunter within hear_radius (cells) of a chasing hunter flanks the runner that chase is after, with hear_flank odds (0 = off). split / split_dist / split_turn: odds a team member takes its own room split_dist cells from the sighting, fanned split_turn radians per team slot (0 = off). clear_radius / clear_memory: a search point a hunter comes within clear_radius cells of is cleared for the squad, the newest clear_memory kept, and directed hunters are not sent back into it (0 = off). Standard keeps hear and split off so its draws and relay rush match the current game.
